correctness.rationale: Exact projection moments give coefficients a_i=3E[Y_i f(Y)]; integration by parts gives (3/2)E[(1-Y_i^2)partial_i f]. Duality of ell-infinity/ell-one yields sum absolute derivatives <=1 a.e.; beta tail integration gives the finite strict upper bound. Median-of-odd-coordinates has unit Lipschitz constant, a.e. single-coordinate derivative, and beta second moment 1/(k+2), yielding lower bounds and the exact dimension-free limit 3/2. Rational checks reproduce sample cases, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The constant 3/2 is best possible uniformly across every dimension of a natural multivariate continuous least-squares projector; it gives a precise dimension-free stability guarantee in a Lipschitz topology despite potentially large uniform-norm amplification. The median witnesses demonstrate unavoidable large-dimensional loss and explicit expansion already for d=3. Exact constants for every fixed dimension are not claimed.
